problem: The paired-25 candidate retrieved every gold document for five Judge-wrong cases, yet several exact answers may be hidden outside the truncated anchor preview and the current tool forbids reopening anchors.
simplest_baseline: Keep the existing 2,000-character document head and make no provider or search calls.
hypothesis: A deterministic window selected by the answer-critical obligation exposes literal answer spans that the same-size document head hides.
anti_claim: This gold-aware oracle does not measure end-to-end accuracy, tool choice, synthesis quality, official benchmark performance, or model capability.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Adding isolated researchers does not reveal a distant span inside a document already retrieved by the single agent.
Generic compression can discard the answer-bearing tail; the local failure calls for an auditable obligation-to-span operation before compression.
More crawl breadth is not the minimal response when the correct source is already present but truncated.
A wider search graph targets missing branches rather than answer-span availability inside a known document.

frozen_controls: retrieved gold docids from saved run traces
next_action: Preregister a paid, outcome-selected calibration of obligation-conditioned span opening; require actual tool use and answer repair before any fresh-slice comparison.
claim_boundary: Four of five full gold documents literally contain all answer atoms; the deterministic selected span exposes four while the same-size head exposes one. Query 715 was spotchecked before registration, but three of the other four cases also pass. This supports only the mechanism's availability precondition.
